message:
I remember the last time we had a power outage—my friend Sarah called in a total tizzy. She was convinced we were headed for the Stone Age! I couldn’t help but chuckle as I rummaged through my emergency supplies, pulling out flashlights and a couple of power banks. 

While Sarah was fretting about her Wi-Fi, I offered her a lantern and suggested we make a cozy night of it, complete with board games and snacks from the fridge. It turned out to be a delightful evening, and we even laughed about her panic later. 

It’s a great reminder that a little preparedness can turn a potential hassle into a fun adventure. How do you keep calm during a blackout?
